name: Mortal Kombat 4 — Goro Biography (Home Versions)
notes: Primary home-version biography reproduced by TRMK. It states that the Mortal Kombat title was won from Goro by Liu Kang, providing later Original-continuity confirmation of Liu Kang's victory over Goro. The biography contains a known ancestor/descendant wording error about Liu Kang's relation to the original Kung Lao; this source is not used for that genealogy claim.
